title: Quantum gravity around ultracold black holes from DSSYK
summary: We propose a quantum description of the ultracold Reissner-Nordström de Sitter black hole via a specific flat space limit of the double-scaled SYK model. Fluctuations in this regime reduce to flat JT gravity, which is ill-behaved as a quantum system. We show that including the first subleading correction to the dilaton potential breaks the leading order Hagedorn degeneracy but does not resolve the structural problem.
